headline: Bybit Targets Broker Partnerships to Compete With Robinhood in US
summary: Bybit CEO Ben Zhou stated the cryptocurrency exchange will look to partner with major traditional brokers like Interactive Brokers to enter the US market.
why: Bybit is a major global digital asset exchange seeking regulatory-compliant pathways into the US retail trading sector.

impacts.name: Interactive Brokers
impacts.why: Collaborating with offshore crypto exchanges could expand brokerage product offerings.
